watch.summary: A streamer tries to hide in tall reeds from an enemy drone, whispering in fear before screaming as he gets spotted and shot.

beats.what: The streamer hides in tall grass as a drone approaches.
He whispers nervously, begging the drone not to scan him.
The drone hovers directly over him and scans his position.
He bursts into a high-pitched scream and flees as lasers fire at him.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The dynamic contrast between his tense, quiet whispering while hiding and his sudden high-pitched scream when spotted delivers immediate comedic value.
